Latest quarter Jun 2026: Excellent (sales +90% YoY, profit +178% YoY)
Cost quality excellent: costs falling, margin expanding, operating profit growing (costs 81% to 73% of sales)
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 97% of 3-year profit
risks: Working capital stretching - debtor days 92 to 82, inventory days 173 to 167 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Domestic institutions (mutual funds, insurers) cut holding by 2.5 pts in a year

guidance: And we expect further momentum through FY '27, including incremental volumes from the pickup truck program, new platforms, and facelift programs.
And one such program, we expect, will start in FY '28.
capex: I mean, we are looking at a possible commissioning in 29.
So, I believe we will have capacity on that line of 400 a day, about 120,000 a year on that new line, which will go into our Shirwal facility.
risks: So, the opportunity also therefore presents challenges in terms of execution bandwidth.
The challenge, of course, is to now convert this into awards and awards into revenue streams.
focus: This gives us a much stronger and more diversified foundation to grow better, stronger, and faster.
We are strengthening our relationships with existing customers, while our capabilities are also attracting new customers and new applications at existing customers.
We have already initiated discussions with several new customers across domestic as well as international markets.
